purpose: Fill the 16 vehicle-category rows that had no part record after Batch 04.
method: Pages fetched with curl (Firecrawl MCP was not connected in this session), saved to disk, converted to text and read line by line. Max 2 model pages per row; extra search pages are listed in urls_checked.
confidence_definition: Same as Batch 04. 'medium' here = vehicle-specific catalogue + part number, no year/variant/VIN fitment.

row_status_definition.found: item-level record with a part number
row_status_definition.related_part_only: only an adjacent part was found
row_status_definition.not_found: no record in the sources inspected (URLs in urls_checked)
